results.answer:
Delivery to Kosovo normally takes 4 to 6 working days [1]. Custom tailoring adds 7 working days to the delivery time [3]. So your tailored dress should arrive in about **11 to 13 working days**.

A few related details:
- Shipping to Kosovo costs 400 MKD, whatever the order size [1].
- Tailoring costs an extra 1,500 MKD [3].
- You'll get a tracking number by email on the day your order ships. Orders placed after 14:00 ship the next working day [2].

The sources don't say whether the 7 tailoring days start from the order date or from when the order ships. They also don't say whether the cutoff time affects that estimate, so the exact arrival date may vary slightly.
